guide.title: Mal'Ganis's Overview
guide.text:
Mal'Ganis is a Tank who relies on a really good amount of
self-sustain to stay alive, allowing him to harass
the enemy backline in order to create space for his team.
Be careful while playing him because most of his Abilities can be
interrupted by crowd control
effects (say Raynor using his knockback to
mess up Night Rush), something that can easily become
frustrating, especially if you do not pay enough attention to it and/or not
adapt your playstyle accordingly.

guide.title: Mal'Ganis's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
High survivability
Decent damage output
Good crowd control
Decent waveclear
Weaknesses
Weak to kiting (e.g. Lunara)
Vulnerable to interrupts, especially on his Heroic Abilities
Not able to peel from high mobility Heroes (like Illidan)
Weak to Root (e.g. Deckard Cain)

guide.title: Mal'Ganis's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Mal'Ganis synergizes with
Mal'Ganis performs better with a Mage
(such as Kel'Thuzad) that can follow up on his
crowd control or with some Bruisers
(like Sonya) or some Melee Assassins
(such as Illidan) that can dive on a given target
Hero while the rest of the enemy team is Sleeping.
Mal'Ganis is countered by
Mal'Ganis is susceptible to enemy Heroes that can quickly Displace him away during
Night Rush (such as Raynor with
Penetrating Round) or lock him down with
crowd control to deny him any chance to use his
Heroic Ability (like Garrosh with
Warlord's Challenge) while he is getting
focused down to death. Heroes with a lot of
mobility (such as Zeratul) are hard to hit for
Mal'Ganis, so he will not be able to provide any peeling
from them. Heroes with a lot of range (such as Hanzo) can easily
kite Mal'Ganis, rendering him quite unimpactful. Another
weakness he has is the fact that Heroes with Roots
(such as Deckard Cain) can stop Mal'Ganis in place during
Night Rush.

guide.title: Mal'Ganis's Maps
guide.text:
Mal'Ganis's stronger maps
Mal'Ganis's average maps
Mal'Ganis's weaker maps
Mal'Ganis is good on Maps that have narrow passages and corridors, allowing
him to get amazing area of effect
value from most of his Abilities, and/or where the Objective does not
spawn too often because he really needs his Heroic Ability in order to
be a complete Hero, but he is bad on Maps that do not have good places where
to flank from.

guide.title: Mal'Ganis's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
Since his engage tools have a limited range, it is better to flank enemy Heroes.
Using Night Rush immediately after the third activation of Fel Claws will make it hard for the focused enemy Hero to react between the Stun and the Sleep.
It is advised to crowd control nearby enemy Heroes before using your Heroic Ability, so that they cannot interrupt it.
Sometimes it is useful not to use Fel Claws three times in quick succession to keep its Stun ready, to use the next activation for mobility, or to maximize your damage output by using Basic Attacks in between.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Mal'Ganis's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Mal'Ganis is a situational Tank
that excels when paired with Heroes who can easily
follow up on his engage with
burst damage and/or additional
crowd control. During team fights, he is able to
survive in the enemy backline for a while, wreaking
havoc in the enemy formation while providing distraction for his allies to do
their work.
Since his engage does not have a lot of range, it is advised
to rely a lot on flanking when playing him,
however, some Heroes can play around that strategy by giving vision
(say Chromie with her Time Trap) and some Tank
players can predict this strategy and position on key points to nullify it.

abilities.title: Mal'Ganis's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
Since his engage tools have a limited range, it is better to flank enemy Heroes.
Using Night Rush immediately after the third activation of Fel Claws will make it hard for the focused enemy Hero to react between the Stun and the Sleep.
It is advised to crowd control nearby enemy Heroes before using your Heroic Ability, so that they cannot interrupt it.
Sometimes it is useful not to use Fel Claws three times in quick succession to keep its Stun ready, to use the next activation for mobility, or to maximize your damage output by using Basic Attacks in between.

abilities.title: Fel Claws
abilities.text:
Fel Claws
(Q)
Mal'Ganis
Mana: 45
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Violently slash in the chosen direction, dealing 66 (+4% per level) damage to enemies.
Reactivate to slash up to 2 more times. The third slash Stuns enemies for 0.75 seconds.
Fel Claws consists of an
area of effect swipe that affects all enemies
caught within its path. The unique aspect of this Ability is that it can be
reactivated twice per cooldown, but only within 3 seconds of casting it.
Even if you cannot immediately see the
cooldown ticking, it starts counting as soon as you cast the first slash.
The last reactivation will also Stun all enemies hit. Although you can
do a good amount of damage with Fel Claws, you should
generally use it as a form of engage, peeling,
or to get out of danger when needed.

abilities.title: Necrotic Embrace
abilities.text:
Necrotic Embrace
(W)
Mal'Ganis
Mana: 35
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Desecrate the air, dealing 121 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies and gaining 15 Spell Armor for 3 Seconds.
This ability's base damage provides double healing from Vampiric Touch.
Necrotic Embrace is a versatile Basic Ability which can
be used defensively and/or offensively depending on the situation. You can use it
offensively when you need to deal damage and defensively when you need survivability.
If you use it both offensively and defensively at the same time, you get even more
value because its damage gets converted into healing with double value from
Vampiric Touch.
When fighting against enemy Heroes, try to cast Necrotic Embrace when you expect
crowd control and/or burst damage
to hit you really soon, so that you will have 15 Spell Armor
while taking damage. If you need to finish off an enemy Hero, do not hesitate
to use this Ability only for dealing damage to help secure the kill.

abilities.title: Night Rush
abilities.text:
Night Rush
(E)
Mal'Ganis
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 14 seconds
After 0.63 seconds, gain 50% Movement Speed for 2 seconds. While active, Mal'Ganis can move through enemy Heroes and put them to Sleep for 2.5 seconds.
After a short cast time,
Night Rush grants Mal'Ganis a nice boost in Movement Speed.
Any enemy Hero getting in contact with him during the effect will be put to
Sleep for a few seconds. Remember that it also makes Mal'Ganis immune to
collision with Heroes for the duration.
If you want to pass through enemy Heroes, use it. If you want to
body block an enemy Hero, then you have to cancel
it by pressing the same key again.

abilities.title: Carrion Swarm
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Carrion Swarm
(R)
Mal'Ganis
Heroic
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 100 seconds
After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.
Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.
Carrion Swarm can deal moderate damage to several enemy Heroes
while also healing Mal'Ganis a sizable amount, however, it is mostly used as a great source
of survivability and escape, especially after getting quickly burst down after
engaging. Keep in mind
that we are talking about a mobile channeled Ability
that requires a short cast time, therefore it can easily be
interrupted by a careful enemy player using
Stun or Silence effects, but not
knockback effects. If it happens to be interrupted, Mal'Ganis
will have a very difficult time to survive. For the same reason, it is highly
advised not to engage or play aggressively when it is on cooldown.

abilities.title: Dark Conversion
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Dark Conversion
(R)
Mal'Ganis
Heroic
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.
Dark Conversion is a unique Heroic
Ability that requires quite a bit of finesse to effectively pull off. After a
short cast time, it causes Mal'Ganis to swap Health percentages with the target
Hero. Remember to make sure that the Health percentage of the enemy Hero is
higher than Mal'Ganis's Health percentage, else it will end up healing the enemy
Hero instead of dealing damage to it and damaging Mal'Ganis instead of
healing him. Due to how it works, it deals more damage on Heroes that have high maximum Health
(such as Stitches), however, it is not considered percent-based damage,
therefore it can be affected by damage modifers. A well-timed interrupt
will deny its cast and put it on a 10-second cooldown.

abilities.title: Vampiric Touch
abilities.text:
Vampiric Touch
(D)
Mal'Ganis
Passive
Mal'Ganis heals for 50% of damage dealt to enemy Heroes and 15% of damage dealt to non-Heroes.
While not being Mal'Ganis's strongest surviving tool when in trouble,
Vampiric Touch is his primary source of survivability
while fighting in close range. The low but consistent self-healing it provides
is something that the enemy team should not overlook because it easily adds up.
Although the healing is way higher when damaging Heroes, it is good to know that
it works when hitting non-Heroes as well.

talent_pages.title: Level 1 Talents for Mal'Ganis
talent_pages.text:
?
Will of Tichondrius
(Level 1)
Mal'Ganis
Quest: Hit Heroes with Fel Claws to permanently increase Fel Claw's damage by 0.25.
Quest: Hit 4 Heroes in the first 2 slashes to cause the final slash to increase damage by 1.
Reward: Upon gaining 20 bonus damage, the final Stun is increased by 0.25 seconds and the final slash steals 4% of enemy Hero Health.
Will of Tichondrius is a good Talent that increases
the damage done by Fel Claws. Hit enemy Heroes with
Fel Claws to gain 0.25 damage bonus. In addition to that, if you hit 4 enemy
Heroes with the first 2 slashes, the final slash will grant 1 damage bonus.
Upon gaining 20 bonus damage, Fel Claws steals 4% of maximum Health from
enemy Heroes and the final slash Stun enemies
for an additional 0.25 seconds, so for a total of 1 second.
We find this Talent useful against Heroes that have high maximum Health
(such as Stitches), especially if they have Armor
(like Deathwing). Do not worry about the fact you will not always
be able to get full value out of it by hitting multiple enemy
Heroes at the same time with a single Fel Claws
to get the bonus Stun duration.
If you plan to pick Blind as a Bat at Level 16,
you should heavily prefer picking this Talent. By making the
Stun from Fel Claws last
slightly longer, this Talent makes it easier to hit enemy Heroes multiple
times in quick succession during Blind as a Bat.
Note that they will always have a small time window to react between Stuns.
?
Winged Guard
(Level 1)
Mal'Ganis
Each time Necrotic Embrace hits an enemy Hero, gain 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack.
If Winged Guard has no charges, Mal'Ganis will gain 1 charge after 5 seconds.
Winged Guard is a situational Talent that gives
Physical Armor in the form of
Block charges
when hitting enemy Heroes with Necrotic Embrace. Furthermore,
if you stay at 0 Block charges for 5 seconds, you passively gain 1 Block charge.
Block charges are especially valuable
when facing Heroes with slow but heavy-hitting Basic Attacks (such as Hanzo) and
terrible when playing against Heroes with fast-hitting Basic Attacks (D.Va,
Genji, Kharazim, Lúcio, Tassadar, Tracer,
and Tychus). Heroes with Clones (for example Nova) can consume them faster
too, however, it is generally not a problem because their AI will not always target you.
✔
Time to Feed
(Level 1)
Mal'Ganis
Mal'Ganis heals for 70 (+4% per level) when damaging a nearby enemy Hero. This can occur once every 6 seconds against each enemy Hero, but is also refreshed when they are Slept by Night Rush.
Time to Feed is a good Talent to increase
Mal'Ganis's survivability when hitting enemy Heroes.
Once picked, this Talent will show a mark on any nearby Hero that can
trigger the bonus healing when damaged by Mal'Ganis.
The unique effect of this Talent consists of healing Mal'Ganis for a fixed
amount each time he damages an enemy Hero, but only once every 6 seconds per
enemy Hero. Sleeping enemy Heroes with
Night Rush will refresh their mark,
allowing you to heal again from the same Hero before the 6-second cooldown expires.
Hitting enemy Heroes with Carrion Swarm
or even with Seeker Swarm at Level 20
will trigger this Talent as well.

talent_pages.text:

(Level 4)
Mal'Ganis
Necrotic Embrace now provides 35 Armor for 3 seconds.
Might of Sargeras is a strong Talent
which upgrades Necrotic Embrace's defensive
effect from 15 Spell Armor to
35 Armor. This effect can be used
to make Mal'Ganis quite resistant when he needs it the most.
In particular, having more Armor
is great for mitigating burst damage.
Against coordinated opponents, make sure to activate it before
being hit by crowd-control effects:
using it when at low Health will result in less damage reduction.
?
Echo of Doom
(Level 4)
Mal'Ganis
When Necrotic Embrace expires, it explodes again for 68 (+4% per level) damage. For each enemy Hero hit, gain 5 Mana and reduce the cooldown of Necrotic Embrace by 0.75 seconds.
Does not wake Sleeping targets.
Echo of Doom is a decent Talent that makes
Necrotic Embrace explode for about half its damage
after 3 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduce its cooldown and restores Mana.
The explosion does not break Sleep, so you do not have to worry about it.
You may want to pick this Talent when you really want additional damage against enemy Heroes
and/or, more importantly, to compensate the lack of clear in your team.
?
Vampiric Aura
(Level 4)
Mal'Ganis
Mal'Ganis heals for 40% of Physical Damage dealt, and nearby allied Heroes heal for 20% of Physical Damage dealt.
Vampiric Aura is a decent Talent that
heals Mal'Ganis for 40% of the Physical Damage dealt and allied Heroes
and 20% of the Physical Damage dealt.
We find this Talent useful to help allied Heroes that use Basic Attacks a
lot and that like to have additional survivability (such as Greymane).
Since it provides healing, this Talent pairs well with Armor
effects (for example Avoidance by Cassia).
Remember that allied Heroes must be within 8 range to benefit from this Talent.
Furthermore, due to it being based on Basic Attacks, enemy Heroes who have access to
Blinds (notably Johanna) can make this Talent less effective.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Mal'Ganis
talent_pages.text:
?
Black Claws
(Level 7)
Mal'Ganis
After Mal'Ganis hits an enemy Hero with Fel Claws, his next Basic Attack deals 60% more damage and reduces the Armor of enemy Heroes by 15 for 2 seconds.
Black Claws is a good Talent that increases your
Attack Damage after every usage of Fel Claws and make
them reduce the Armor of enemy Heroes by a decent amount
for a few seconds.
When possible, try to alternate Fel Claws and
Basic Attacks to increase the uptime of the Armor debuff.
When not possible, even if you will get less value from this Talent by using all
charges of Fel Claws in quick succession, the Armor
reduction bonus will still help you and your team deal more damage.
We find this Talent useful when your team is trying to burst
down enemy Heroes and/or when playing against Heroes who have
Armor increase effects (for example Deathwing).
?
Fueled by Torment
(Level 7)
Mal'Ganis
Necrotic Embrace now Slows nearby enemies by 25% for 3 seconds.
Fueled by Torment is a decent Talent which causes
Necrotic Embrace to apply a moderate Slow
to enemies (including non-Heroes) who take damage from it.
If you have this Talent, you can use Necrotic Embrace
right before Fel Claws to make it slightly harder for
enemy Heroes to dodge you. This is only useful if they have
Movement Speed buffs, otherwise they would be easy enough to hit.
✔
Spreading Plague
(Level 7)
Mal'Ganis
After casting Night Rush, deal 33 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. This effect lasts for 5 seconds and Basic Attacks against Heroes refresh its duration.
Does not wake Sleeping targets.
Spreading Plague is a good Talent that gives
Mal'Ganis more sustain damage in an area around him,
and therefore more self-sustain
from Vampiric Touch.
Remember that hitting the affected Hero with a
Basic Attack will refresh its duration, however, the effect provided is strong
enough even if you cannot refresh it multiple times.
The area of effect damage done by
Spreading Plague can trigger
Time to Feed at Level 1 without waking up
Sleeping targets and can provide
Movement Speed via Blood Rush at Level 13.
If you have this Talent, you can use Night Rush
for clearing Minions when necessary, but keep an eye on your positioning
and Mana when doing so because that is your only mobility
tool and it is your most expensive Basic Ability.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Mal'Ganis
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Carrion Swarm
(Level 10)
Mal'Ganis
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 100 seconds
After 1 second, disperse into an Invulnerable swarm of bats for 3 seconds, dealing 120 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies.
Vampiric Touch heals for 75% of Carrion Swarm's damage to Heroes.
Carrion Swarm is the preferred choice because of
two main reasons: it has a shorter cast time compared to
Dark Conversion and it can be cast while moving,
meaning that knockback effects (say Raynor
with Penetrating Round)
and other daze effects will not
interrupt it.
?
Dark Conversion
(Level 10)
Mal'Ganis
Mana: 60
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Channel on an enemy Hero for 0.75 seconds, then swap Health percentages with the target over 3 seconds.
Dark Conversion is situational for when there is
an urgent need of additional damage, usually because the enemy team has a Hero
with high maximum Health (like Stitches)
without ways to mitigate Spell Damage
as this Ability does not deal percent-based damage
despite being based on maximum Health.
Note that Dark Conversion is easier to
interrupt than Carrion Swarm.
Since it is a stationary channel instead
of a mobile channel, it can also be
interrupted by Knockback effects.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Mal'Ganis
talent_pages.text:
?
Deep Sleep
(Level 13)
Mal'Ganis
Increase Night Rush's Sleep duration by 0.75 seconds and its Movement Speed bonus by 15%.
Deep Sleep is a situational Talent that provides
15% additional Movement Speed during Night Rush
on top of the baseline 50% additional Movement Speed,
allowing you to move at 165% total Movement Speed. This effect can be used to better close
the gap with the enemy Heroes you want to engage.
✘
The Night Beckons
(Level 13)
Mal'Ganis
Basic Attacks deal 200% bonus damage to Sleeping enemies. After Night Rush's Sleep ends, targets are Slowed by 30% for 3 seconds.
The Night Beckons is a weak Talent because, while
it can be used to apply a decent Slow to all enemy Heroes,
it competes with Talents that actually help Mal'Ganis to reach the enemy
Heroes in the first place, something that is way more important for him.
✔
Blood Rush
(Level 13)
Mal'Ganis
When Mal'Ganis is healed by a Hero, he gains 1% Movement Speed for 6 seconds, up to 15%.
Blood Rush is a strong Talent in most if not all
matches because it provides Mal'Ganis
more mobility, which is quite noticeable and useful when it comes to
engaging enemy Heroes or escaping dangerous situations.
In addition to that, it has synergy with Spreading Plague
at Level 7 and Carrion Swarm at Level 10.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Mal'Ganis
talent_pages.text:
✔
Plague Bats
(Level 16)
Mal'Ganis
Necrotic Embrace unleashes a wave of bats in front of Mal'Ganis, dealing 81 (+4% per level) damage.
Plague Bats is a good Talent that increases
his burst damage by a solid amount. Considering
that it deals damage only in front of Mal'Ganis, remember to change his
orientation before using it.
?
Frenzied Assault
(Level 16)
Mal'Ganis
Basic Attacks against Heroes with a higher Health percentage heal for an additional 50% of damage dealt.
Basic Attacks against Heroes with a lower Health percentage grant 35% Attack Speed for 3 seconds.
Frenzied Assault is a decent Talent that gives Mal'Ganis
a fair amount of Attack Speed when hitting enemy Heroes who have a lower Health percentage
than him or makes his Basic Attack heal him for an additional 50% of the damage dealt
when hitting enemy Heroes who have a higher Health percentage than him.
?
Blind as a Bat
(Level 16)
Mal'Ganis
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to erupt with blind rage, removing the cooldown and Mana cost of Fel Claws, but losing all vision. Lasts 5.5 seconds.
Enemy Heroes hit by the final slash of Fel Claws reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 4 seconds.
Does not provide quest stacks while active.
Blind as a Bat is a strong Talent that allows Mal'Ganis to deal
an insane amount of area of effect damage, however, not being able
to see anything puts him at a significant
disadvantage because he will not be able to reliably hit enemy Heroes or to dodge
enemy Abilities when needed.
While it is generally a good Talent, we find this Talent stronger on Maps
that feature at least 1 Boss Camp
and/or various choke points
and narrow corridors (such as Cursed Hollow).
In case you opted for this Talent, remember that it can also be used to escape!
To get the most out of this Talent, combine it with Will of Tichondrius
at Level 1. Catch at least 1 enemy Hero with the final slash of Fel Claws
and then activate Blind as a Bat to repeatedly hit them.
Note that they will always have a small time window to react between Stuns.
Yon can rely on sound effects to understand if you are hitting enemy Heroes or not.
If you are not full Health, you can also use the green healing numbers as a guide
to figure out if you are hitting enemy Heroes or not.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Mal'Ganis
talent_pages.text:
✔
Seeker Swarm
(Level 20)
Mal'Ganis
Upon expiring, Carrion Swarm's bats seek nearby enemy Heroes, dealing 132 (+4% per level) damage and Sleeping them for 2.5 seconds.
Seeker Swarm is a great upgrade to the already very powerful
Carrion Swarm. The ability to put enemy Heroes
to Sleep from the distance at the cost of a major defensive
cooldown allows Mal'Ganis to set up a powerful engage.
If your team is trying to kill one target, you can keep the rest of the enemy
team unable to act by using Night Rush on them right before
the Sleep effect from Seeker Swarm ends.
The damage done by Seeker Swarm can
trigger Time to Feed at Level 1 on enemy Heroes
who are too far to be hit by Carrion Swarm.
✘
Wrath of Nathreza
(Level 20)
Mal'Ganis
Enemy Heroes near the target suffer 85% of the transferred Health as damage over 3 seconds.
Does not benefit from Vampiric Touch.
Wrath of Nathreza is considered a bad choice because
it counts on the enemy team to misplay by having multiple Heroes one
near the other in the same location and not having any interrupt.
?
Vanquish the Weak
(Level 20)
Mal'Ganis
Damage from Fel Claws and Basic Attacks Slows enemies by 25% for 1.5 seconds, and Vampiric Touch converts 10% more damage into healing versus Slowed Heroes.
Vanquish the Weak is a decent alternative in case you
need a bit more power against melee Heroes, however, it is rarely the choice
because the other options are usually more interesting and more useful.
?
Alone in the Dark
(Level 20)
Mal'Ganis
Reduce the cooldown of Night Rush by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes put to Sleep by Night Rush have their vision greatly reduced during the Sleep and for 2 seconds after.
Alone in the Dark is a situational Talent that can make the life
harder for all enemy Heroes that get caught by Night Rush,
effectively increasing the crowd control
that it provides. The cooldown reduction helps you use it twice in a single team fight.
